homepage.name: Patagonia
homepage.caption: “Performance Foundations — For the pursuit of your wildest days.”
homepage.observation: Softens activism, foregrounds performance. A quiet pivot from cause-led to capability-led messaging.

homepage.name: Arc'teryx
homepage.caption: “Fresh Off the Line — Spring Climbing Collection”
homepage.observation: Product-first, calendar-driven. Frames the site as a drop culture destination — closer to streetwear than gear.

homepage.name: The North Face
homepage.caption: “finding your moment in the sun”
homepage.observation: Leads with a lifestyle mood, not product. 'Moment in the sun' softens the mountain codes — chasing warmth-seekers, not just climbers.

social.name: Patagonia
social.observation: Documentary aesthetic. Real people, real places. Still the most editorial feed, but noticeably less protest, more product.

social.name: Arc'teryx
social.observation: Cold palette, alpine-only. Disciplined to the point of narrow — no lifestyle, no compromise on the mountain.

social.name: The North Face
social.observation: Warm palette, sun-drenched. Feed reads editorial travel more than technical outdoor — broadening beyond core.
